title: Tower Isles
hook: Fight round the old tower and across the bridge: every blast bites a crater out of the island, or out of the tower itself.
prompt: an artillery party game where friends fight around a ruined stone tower on an island and across a bridge to the next island, and bombs blow craters in the ground and the tower

controls.primary: lob a bomb where you aim

round.winBy: most points when time is up: a bomb that knocks a friend scores, a friend you send into the sea scores more

world.notes: A composed level: the ruined tower stands on the middle island with a plaza round it, a gatehouse crowns the next island, and a bridge spans the gap; all three are ground (stand on them, blast holes in them). The seats come in pairs that see each other and the tower.

mechanics.as: a lobbed bomb that bursts where it lands
every blast carves a round crater in the ground, on every screen

rules.summary: Aim and lob bombs. A blast carves a crater and throws anyone near it. Knocking a friend scores 1; a friend who falls into the sea scores 3 for whoever threw the last bomb at them, and they come back on their island. Most points when time is up wins.
rules.scoring: +1 per friend knocked by your blast, +3 when a friend you knocked falls into the sea

characters.describe: a round jelly-bean bomber in a helmet

sounds.describe: falling into the sea, a big splash

accept: friends see each other and the tower from where they start
a bomb carves a crater in the ground or in the tower, the same on every screen
the bridge can be walked across
a friend knocked into the sea scores for the thrower

content.notes: Cartoon bombs: beans get thrown about and splash into the sea, nobody is hurt.
